credentialShapeCheck.interpretation: No output values; empty matches do not prove absence of secrets. Binary data, every credential format, and all external copies were not audited.

rightsRecords.finding: Sample stock/original assets and third-party research evidence are explicitly separated; credit and source verification is recorded, but inspected documentation does not establish a blanket grant to redistribute every research photo/frame or archived webpage.

officialSources.supports: Public repository visibility differs from an open-source reuse license; public view/fork and existing copies.
Public visibility exposes code and related repository history; privacy switch is a separate action.

resolved.objection: Does publicising the current full tool require a separate publication packager, private source repository, and notes removal?
resolved.resolution: No: if full source/examples/research/history disclosure is intended, current relative paths and sample notes can be published directly; Pages setup is separate.

resolved.objection: Does sharing a presentation URL imply permission to disclose all 383 tracked files, 310 research files, WORK_LOG, and 10 commits?
resolved.resolution: No: website artifact selection does not hide the public Git repository or its history; choose based on the intended disclosure scope.

resolved.objection: Does the lack of a LICENSE or unverified blanket redistribution grant prove publishing is technically prohibited or unlawful?
resolved.resolution: No: public visibility, open-source reuse licensing, and third-party material permissions are distinct; document what was checked without making a legal determination.
